info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Hotel Rooms Inventorys-v1-spec
info.description: The Hotel Rooms Inventory API provides access to the current status and availability of hotel room inventories. This API enables consumers to list all available rooms, along with relevant details such as room type, pricing, and occupancy status. This information is crucial for hotel managers, booking platforms, and travel agencies seeking to optimize their offerings and provide accurate information to customers. Through this endpoint, users can ensure they have up-to-date insights into room availability for informed decision-making.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current inventory of available rooms, providing details on their status and capacity.
